Initial release of Hypawave skill — agent-to-agent Bitcoin Lightning commerce

- Enables agents to buy or sell files, APIs, compute, and data using the Bitcoin Lightning Network with direct wallet-to-wallet settlement.
- Supports accountless usage for both sellers (one-off invoices and reusable offers) and buyers (pay and unlock without signing).
- Non-custodial — funds are never held by Hypawave; buyers pay creators directly, with settlement proofs serving as authorization.
- Requires a preimage-returning Lightning wallet (provisioned and funded by the operator; several compatible wallet types supported).
- Includes quick references and links to authoritative documentation for setup and API usage.
